contexts.environment_transitions: at most one nondeterministic change after any visible-event boundary, from/to any target-freshness state

relation: For every finite context script (initial state plus zero or one environment transition at a visible-event boundary) and cancellation point, exact equality of visible event traces. Only INTERNAL stutters. Unsupported operations and exceeded bounds are UNKNOWN and cannot certify.

source_rules.cancel: before a nonterminal source step at the selected visible-event count, release then abort_cancel
source_rules.guard: sets authority only when fresh=true and active_target equals target; otherwise release then abort
source_rules.write: requires prior matching guard and still-fresh matching target; otherwise release then abort

target_rules.EMIT: emits declared effect even if unguarded; validator must reject any source-trace mismatch
target_rules.INTERNAL: stutters unless a side_effect field is present, which emits a forbidden event
target_rules.cancel_handler: run handler on cancellation; frozen valid handler is RELEASE then ABORT_CANCEL
